use default
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE

use Point = (x: int, y: int)

let points =
    [(x = 16, y = 3), (x = 12, y = 17), (x = 0, y = 6),
     (x = -4, y = -6), (x = 16, y = 6), (x = 16, y = -7),
     (x = 16, y = -3), (x = 17, y = -4), (x = 5, y = 19),
     (x = 19, y = -8), (x = 3, y = 16), (x = 12, y = 13),
     (x = 3, y = -4), (x = 17, y = 5), (x = -3, y = 15),
     (x = -3, y = -9), (x = 0, y = 11), (x = -9, y = -3),
     (x = -4, y = -2), (x = 12, y = 10)]

turn(from: Point, through: Point, to: Point) -> int =>
    (through.x - from.x) * (to.y - from.y) -
    (through.y - from.y) * (to.x - from.x)

half_hull(ordered: Collections.List[Point]) -> LIST[Point] is
    let side = LIST[Point]()

    for at in ordered do
        while side.count > 1 /\
                turn(side[side.count - 2],
                     side[side.count - 1], at) <= 0 do
            side.remove_at(side.count - 1)
        od

        side.add(at)
    od

    side.remove_at(side.count - 1)

    return side
si

let ordered =
    points
        |> sort((a: Point, b: Point) =>
            if a.x != b.x then a.x - b.x else a.y - b.y fi)
        |> collect_list()

let backwards =
    (0..ordered.count)
        |> map(step => ordered[ordered.count - 1 - step])
        |> collect_list()

let hull = half_hull(ordered)

for at in half_hull(backwards) do
    hull.add(at)
od

let spelled = hull |> map(at => "({at.x},{at.y})") |> join(", ")

write_line("{points.count} points")
write_line("hull of {hull.count}: {spelled}")

let image = IMAGE(600, 600)

image.colour(90ub, 90ub, 100ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.fit(-11.0D, -11.0D, 21.0D, 21.0D)
axes.draw()

let corners =
    LIST(hull |> map(at =>
        (x = cast double(at.x), y = cast double(at.y))))

image.colour(206ub, 224ub, 244ub)
image.fill(corners)

corners.add(corners[0])

image.colour(40ub, 92ub, 168ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)
image.line(corners)

for at in points do
    image.colour(60ub, 60ub, 70ub)
    image.dot(cast double(at.x), cast double(at.y), 3.5D)
od

for at in hull do
    image.colour(216ub, 64ub, 48ub)
    image.dot(cast double(at.x), cast double(at.y), 5.0D)
od

image.write("hull.png")

image.show("hull.png")
